Metadata.Name: Quarterly Privileged Access Review
Metadata.Description: Quarterly review of privileged accounts to ensure access is still required and appropriate.

Activity.Name: Generate Privileged Account Report
Activity.Description: Extract a full list of privileged accounts from the identity store for review.

Activity.Name: System Owner Certification
Activity.Description: Each system owner certifies that listed privileged accounts are still required.

Activity.Name: CISO Sign-off
Activity.Description: CISO reviews the certification results and approves before remediation proceeds.

Activity.Name: Revoke Uncertified Access
Activity.Description: Revoke all accounts that were not certified or explicitly rejected during review.
